description: R78E: the R77 contract with the review corrections (the committed edge sibling weight (control), the bin-center correction, the exact CM sqrt(s) of the observables)

judgment.f_isovector: 0.2 by judgment (R77: 0.183 at the generation fraction 0.25)

texts.parametrization_space: epsilon, log B_SD, epsilon_nd, logit w_excited, log flavor weights, f_isovector
texts.report_title: R78E: the edge-weight control of the corrected fit
texts.report_kernel_line: the density-weighted continuation step with the P-wave barrier on the isospin-complete towers (baryonic, strange baryonic, strange mesonic) with the Delta-like lines, the sibling weight at the edge mass (the committed rule, control); the exact 2 -> 2 transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the flat three-body phase space; the model bins converted to the tabulated points (the bin-center correction); the isovector exchange fraction free; diffractive shapes free.
texts.obligation: the single fit of the two-component model with the review corrections (R78E)
texts.hypothesis: The R77 kernel with the review corrections (the committed edge sibling weight (control), the bin-center correction, the exact CM sqrt(s)) describes the six p+p species and the neutron dN/dx_F with the two-component model and the isovector exchange; the fit reports the parameters and the residual map as measured.

kernel_change.sibling_weight: the committed q* at the fixed mass max(floor, edge - nominal width) (control)
kernel_change.bin_center: each model bin average of f is multiplied by f(x0, p0) / <f>_bin of the data's own local shape: an error-weighted five-point quadratic in log f along x_F and along p_T through the tabulated neighbors, the tangent at the end of a row; the neutron dN/dx_F by the one-dimensional factor
kernel_change.sqrt_s: the observables boost, x_F and pi sqrt(s) at the exact invariant mass 17.2702 GeV; the draw domain at 17.270
kernel_change.unchanged: the exact transfer window, the per-line thresholds, the three-body phase-space law, the continuation law (density with the P-wave barrier), the source density, the catalog, the flavor ledger

texts.shapes_note: the class fractions stay at the external anchors (diffraction is the owner's global-fit question); the diffractive epsilon and B_SD are free
texts.central_component_basis: R74 and R75 found f_central compatible with zero (intervals 0-0.046 and 0-0.040) on the clamped transfer draw; the barrier-radius probe of 2026-10-06 found the central soft region overfilled without a central component at r0 = 1.0, 2.85 and 5.07 GeV^-1 on the exact window

texts.reading: the isospin of the exchange adjacent to each leading line (the end link of the multiperipheral chain), not the reggeon share of the total cross section
